jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

Who are we looking for?

You are a good fit if you like to coordinate between client, stakeholders and your team. We want you to be part of our team, if you are a good communicator, who knows how to identify customer requirements and manages future business solutions. Resting on your laurels is not familiar to you, nor is it for us.

What do we require?
• Focus on building & maintaining a strong relationship to our clients, respecting their needs and identifying business opportunities
• Experience in requirements management and ability to conceptualize the clients expectations
• Experience in managing medium size contracts and their budgets
• Having at least 1-2 years of experience as a Project Manager or equivalent position
• Ability to moderate workshops, presentations and discussions
• Documentation of complex topics concisely and comprehensibly
• Creating a communication plan and managing its execution
• Excellent... organizational and time management skills
• Acting as a trusted advisor for customers and colleagues
• With the input of the technical team, all technical topics can be discussed and explained to our clients
• Capability to manage a project team, including sub-contractors
• Business travel is not an issue for you
• Fluent (native level) Spanish
• Fluent English
• Eligibility to work within the EU

What makes us smile when looking at your profile
• Experience with Adobe CQ5 or AEM related web projects
• A proactive mind-set, ability to share your ideas and bring them to life
• Enthusiasm
• An open mind which is looking for continuous improvement
• Willingness to develop a stronger understanding of the projects technical components
• Receiving and giving feedback is familiar to you, something you are not afraid of

What we can offer you:
• Permanent contract
• 30 working days of vacation for all employees
• Flexible working hours, with respect to project needs
• Recognition bonus system
• Apple work equipment
• Continuous training and coaching
• Free language classes to polish your English or help you with your Spanish
• Truly international team
• Free Private health insurance
• Tax free benefits (ticket restaurant, kindergarden and transport)
• Sponsored gym membership
• A central office location closed to the Mercado Progreso
• Many off-site company events, including our annual company summits
• Everyone has a voice, we are a Holacracy organization

This offer from "Cognizant Netcentric" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 72% flex score

jobs_results.title: Data & AI Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
EA inspires the world to play, and the Worldwide Localization Team makes that happen! We are accountable for delivering the high-quality localized versions of our titles to over 30 countries around the world. You will find a vibrant, multicultural environment with a great mixture of professionals. From software engineers, project managers, testers to audio, text and linguistic specialists, each employee has an important role to play. EA has built a cutting-edge Localization powerhouse that covers the needs for both current and next-generation platform.

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Data & AI Project Manager to join our dynamic team at Electronic Arts (EA). This role is key to driving our digital transformation efforts, as you'll be leading projects that leverage data and AI to enhance our gaming experiences and business outcomes.

Responsibilities:
• Develop, manage, and lead complex data and AI projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are delivered on... time and within scope and budget.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders, to define project objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
• Identify, assess, and manage potential project risks and obstacles, develop effective mitigation strategies, and maintain open communication with stakeholders.
• Effectively communicate project expectations, progress, and outcomes to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
• Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting the sharing of knowledge and expertise and driving the achievement of shared goals.
• Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of learning and sharing.

Qualifications:
• A PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
• A minimum of 3 years of proven project management experience, focusing on data and AI-related projects.
• Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies, strongly emphasising Agile and Scrum, and knowledge of project management software, especially Jira.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and team-building skills, with a demonstrated ability to motivate and guide diverse teams.
• Ability to develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, successfully managing expectations and resolving conflicts.
• Strong strategic and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate potential issues and create effective solutions.
• Demonstrated leadership skills, with experience in mentoring.
• Interest in gaming is a big plus.

Preferred Skills:
• Certifications in Project Management (PMP, Prince2), Agile, or Scrum would be advantageous.
• Experience in the gaming industry would be a significant plus.
• Familiarity with data visualization and AI tools and platforms.

#LI-VEP1

jobs_results.title: Project Manager IT
jobs_results.description:
Desde la división de IT & Cloud estamos buscando un/a Project Manager del ámbito para una importante empresa (cliente final) en Sevilla

¿Qué harías?

Coordinar las diferentes fases de los proyectos en infraestructuras y comunicaciones
Coordinar al equipo interno, IT, y partners seleccionados para llevar el proyecto en tiempo, alcance, presupuesto y calidad.
Contacto y gestión de proveedores.
Asegurar la implantación de best practices y procesos estándar y escalables.

¿Qué buscamos?

Más de cinco años de experiencia profesional en el área de sistemas.
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en la gestión de proyectos.
Valorable certificación PMP o Prince2
Experiencia y conocimientos de infraestructura de comunicaciones:

Implantación y despliegue de redes de datos: LAN, WAN, WIFI, etc.
Servidores y almacenamiento: NAS, UPS, etc.
Integración de comunicaciones unificadas: VoIP, video, mensajería, correo electrónico, herramientas de colaboración de equipos.
Seguridad de la información: IDS, IPS... IAM, VPNs, etc.
Conocimiento de tecnologías de Virtualización (VMWare, VirtualBox, …)
Conocimiento de tecnologías de contenedores (Docker, Kubernetes, …)
Computación en la nube: arquitecturas públicas, privadas (on-premise) e híbridas. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platfor.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido directamente con cliente final.
1 día de teletrabajo a la semana.
Horario flexible, viernes y verano intensivo.
Retribución flexible

¿Te interesa? Si es así, aplica y contactaremos contigo para ampliar información

jobs_results.title: Global Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Global Project Manager

Description -

Job scope/summary:
• As Partner and Footprint Project manager you will be part of the CS (Customer Support & Services) CCC (Customer Care Center) organization. Partner and Footprint management team is managing partner relationships for the network of delivery partners customer care centers over all the Globe. Objectives of the organization are to provide superior customer experience, rapidly adopt digital and automation, drive Services Revenue Growth and Sustainability.

We have the mission to support Delivery partner CCC on 3 pillars:
• Development & Management of CC partners to achieve an streamlined footprint, operational consistency and resilience while improving customer experience.
• Lead partners to propose and adopt the latest technologies to ensure effortless customer experience, simplified agent journey and cost optimization.
• Adopt New workforce models: Crowdsourcing and Working from home enablement for outsource workforce. Define Ops... excellence on work from home setup.

Your mission will be to lead innovative and transformational projects which may span across business models, footprint changes and efficiency improvements. You will work with regional and global teams, and external partners, in a highly multicultural and multi-country environment.

Job specifics/responsibilities:
• Provides direct and ongoing leadership for a team of individual contributors designing and developing and coordinating projects for partner delivery. Including, new business models, partner changes and efficiency improvements.
• Communicates project status and escalates issues to direct managers, program managers, and internal and external development partners.
• Manages relationships with outsourced partners, including setting expectations regarding deliverables, service quality, schedules, and costs
• Effective communication and collaboration with team members, outsourced resources, sponsors and partners
• Proactively identifies opportunities for process improvement and cost reductions opportunities.
• Lead projects from design to handover to operations.
• Robust Governance Structure
• Keep stakeholders informed and expectations management
• Deliver a solution that works for Operations.

Key deliverables/accountabilities:
• Project objectives being achieved: Savings, implementation dates, adhering to timeline
• Opportunities for efficiency in projects are identified and implemented

Education (degree) and professional experience required:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Process Engineering, Business Administration or equivalent diploma
• Experience working in a virtual team environment

Other requirements:
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including negotiation and influencing skills (Fluent in English is a must)

Personal skills and qualities:
• Familiar with HP Customer Care Center support environment.
• Good understanding of current setup.
• Operations and processes.
• Proven ability to work effectively in a multi-cultural, diverse, virtual global team.
• Strong personal relationship skills.
• Program management expertise and change management skills, ideally: PMP Certified. COPC certification is a plus
• Vendor Management knowledge.
• Proven ability to interact and drive topics to completion and to achieve results in a complex environment.
• Strong ability to collaborate and influence.
• Experience in working with Global Teams is a definite plus
• Seniority and standing, comfortable in interacting on executive level (internal & external).

Technical skills (procedures and documents the employee has to be acquainted with):
• MS Office
• Reporting tool /Data management

We’re looking for visionaries who are ready to make an impact on the way the world works. At HP, the future’s yours to create!

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager - Telco Cloud
jobs_results.description:
For over a decade now, OpenNebula Systems has been leading the development of the European open source technology that helps organizations around the world to manage their corporate data centers and build their Enterprise Clouds.

If you want to join an established leader in the cloud infrastructure industry and the global open source community, keep reading, because you can now join a team of exceptionally passionate and talented colleagues whose mission is to help the world's leading enterprises to implement their next-generation edge and cloud strategies. We are hiring!

Since 2019, and thanks to the support from the European Commission, OpenNebula Systems has been leading the edge computing innovation in Europe, investing heavily in research and open source development, and playing a key role in strategic EU initiatives such as the IPCEI-CIS and the “European Alliance for Industrial Data, Edge and Cloud”.

We are currently looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to come and... join us in Europe as part of our new team developing the next generation integrated solution for the Telco Cloud Edge.

Job Description

As a Technical Project Manager, you will lead a growing team responsible for developing OpenNebula’s strategic investment to be the open-source edge infrastructure company for the Telco Cloud, Edge and 5G. OpenNebula's edge cloud infrastructure platform provides retail, automotive, manufacturing, industrial, telco and other edge market segments with a mission-critical environment for deploying virtualization and kubernetes on remote edge devices. The new integrated solution for the Telco Cloud and Edge will be rich enough to host complex applications but flexible enough to scale from hundreds to millions of instances and be deployed across different vertical edge market segments.

The role will be responsible for delivering successful IT projects to design, develop, integrate, deploy, maintain and validate with use cases a new cloud-edge integrated solution for the Telco Edge market. It requires a broad knowledge of the telco industry and related technologies, deep experience with networking and distributed applications, strong background in cloud systems integration, and previous exposure to large-scale software infrastructure architecture, methodologies and tools. He will work closely with users and use cases to understand needs and translate them into scalable and secure cloud architectures. He will also participate in the upstream community, on challenging projects deploying innovative edge/cloud systems. If you are passionate about open source and about driving technological projects to successful completion and thrive in a collaborative, international and innovation-focused environment, we encourage you to apply.

What you will do
• Technical management of international IT projects from initiation to delivery, ensuring adherence to project scope, milestones, KPIs, timelines, and budget
• Analyzing functional and systems requirements and key case studies for solutions to meet the demands of the Telco Edge market
• Defining the design, roadmap and prototype of the cloud-edge architecture for an end-to-end integrated solution for the Telco Edge market
• Designing the APIs, interfaces and data formats of the software components of the integrated cloud system
• Choosing the appropriate cloud services and technologies for the cloud system, and creating the documentation and diagrams of the Telco Edge integrated solution
• Development and technical leadership of the Telco Edge software components, and their integration, deployment and validation using industry use cases
• Utilizing industry-standard project management methodologies to deliver iterative solutions that align with project goals, including the scheduling, managing and coordinating of software releases
• Identifying and evaluating new technologies, innovations, and helps drive partner relationships for alignment with technology roadmap and business value; creates plans for integration and update into architecture
• Working with other companies in the cloud-edge ecosystem within international projects and open-source communities. Availability to occasional travel and participation in international events and meetings
• Writing and maintaining software documentation and project reports
• Creating an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
• Setting clear team goals, delegating tasks and set deadlines for your internal team
• Deploying agile methodology for geographically distributed international team in design, code, and test-plan reviews to help build robust software and promote knowledge sharing
• Working closely with development and engineering teams, and stakeholders to define project objectives, requirements, and deliverables that meet use cases, collaborations and team needs
• Support PMO in reporting on cost/roadmap/resource forecasting
• Contributing to the preparation of new project proposals in the field

What you will bring
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
• 5+ years of hands-on experience delivering large-scale software projects, preferably including telco-industry infrastructure and/or workloads
• Hands-on experience in managing or contributing to open source projects
• Strong leadership skills, including the ability to set goals and provide constructive feedback respectfully to build positive relationships and improve business results
• Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization and to interact with external stakeholders
• Multi-tasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in a timely manner
• Hands-on experience in Network Functions Virtualization (NFV) and Software-Defined networking (SDN) applied to wireline and wireless networks
• Knowledgeable in 4G and 5G Radio network architecture and ecosystem, and 3GPP specifications
• Knowledgeable in Telco Edge operation, management and orchestration (e.g., MANO), MEX specifications, Network Management, OSS/BSS, and TM Forum standards
• Strong technical knowledge of open-source and/or disaggregated Telco solutions
• Broad experience with Linux operating system development, automation and performance tuning
• History of innovation with examples of developing new technologies, software architecture and designs
• Experience writing Terraform modules and managing deployments of virtualized infrastructures with Terraform
• Experience using public Clouds (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, etc…), understand the limitations and peculiarities of the networking and storage model of each provider
• Experience deploying and using monitoring and alerting tools like Prometheus. Design monitoring metrics and associated data structure. Elaborate and analyze usage reports obtained from the monitor data
• Experience with Cloud Management platforms and their associated technologies. Understand the implication of managing virtualized infrastructures and the orchestration of the underlying subsystems.

What's in it for me?

Some of our benefits and perks vary depending on location and employment type, but we are proud to provide employees with the following:
• Competitive compensation package and flexible remuneration: Meals, Transport, Nursery/Childcare
• Customized workstation (macOS, Windows, Linux)
• Private health insurance
• Paid time off: Holidays, Personal Time, Sick Time, Parental leave
• Afternoon-off every friday and during summer
• Remote company with bright HQ centrally located in Madrid; offices in Boston (USA), Brussels (Belgium) and Brno (Czech Republic); and access to office space near your location when needed. During the first year, for onboarding purposes, and for participation on certain projects, employees should be able to attend events and face-to-face meetings in our Madrid offices and be available to travel to Brussels and maybe other European cities. All employees are also required to attend our company-wide face-to-face all-hands meetings twice a year
• Healthy work-life balance: We encourage the right for Digital Disconnecting and promote harmony between employees personal and professional lives
• Flexible hiring options: Full Time/Part Time, Employee (Spain/USA) / Contractor (other locations)
• We are building an awesome, Engineering First Culture and your opinion matters: Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued
• Be exposed to a broad technology ecosystem. We encourage learning and researching new technologies and methods as part of your everyday duties

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
• 5+ years of hands-on experience delivering large-scale software projects, preferably including telco-industry infrastructure and/or workloads
• Hands-on experience in managing or contributing to open source projects
• Strong leadership skills, including the ability to set goals and provide constructive feedback respectfully to build positive relationships and improve business results
• Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization and to interact with external stakeholders
• Multi-tasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in a timely manner
• Hands-on experience in Network Functions Virtualization (NFV) and Software-Defined networking (SDN) applied to wireline and wireless networks
• Knowledgeable in 4G and 5G Radio network architecture and ecosystem, and 3GPP specifications
• Knowledgeable in Telco Edge operation, management and orchestration (e.g., MANO), MEX specifications, Network Management, OSS/BSS, and TM Forum standards
• Strong technical knowledge of open-source and/or disaggregated Telco solutions
• Broad experience with Linux operating system development, automation and performance tuning
• History of innovation with examples of developing new technologies, software architecture and designs
• Experience writing Terraform modules and managing deployments of virtualized infrastructures with Terraform
• Experience using public Clouds (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, etc…), understand the limitations and peculiarities of the networking and storage model of each provider
• Experience deploying and using monitoring and alerting tools like Prometheus. Design monitoring metrics and associated data structure. Elaborate and analyze usage reports obtained from the monitor data
• Experience with Cloud Management platforms and their associated technologies. Understand the implication of managing virtualized infrastructures and the orchestration of the underlying subsystems.

What's in it for me?

Some of our benefits and perks vary depending on location and employment type, but we are proud to provide employees with the following:
• Competitive compensation package and flexible remuneration: Meals, Transport, Nursery/Childcare
• Customized workstation (macOS, Windows, Linux)
• Private health insurance
• Paid time off: Holidays, Personal Time, Sick Time, Parental leave
• Afternoon-off every friday and during summer
• Remote company with bright HQ centrally located in Madrid; offices in Boston (USA), Brussels (Belgium) and Brno (Czech Republic); and access to office space near your location when needed. During the first year, for onboarding purposes, and for participation on certain projects, employees should be able to attend events and face-to-face meetings in our Madrid offices and be available to travel to Brussels and maybe other European cities. All employees are also required to attend our company-wide face-to-face all-hands meetings twice a year
• Healthy work-life balance: We encourage the right for Digital Disconnecting and promote harmony between employees personal and professional lives
• Flexible hiring options: Full Time/Part Time, Employee (Spain/USA) / Contractor (other locations)
• We are building an awesome, Engineering First Culture and your opinion matters: Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued
• Be exposed to a broad technology ecosystem. We encourage learning and researching new technologies and methods as part of your everyday duties

jobs_results.title: IT Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
NextLink is looking for an IT project manager with experience in applying a blend of creativity analytical thinking project management skills and technical expertise to effectively communicate complex concepts to management level nontechnical audiences in a compelling and understandable manner.

Key Responsabilities:
• Gather information from various sources including meetings reports and data.
• Translate complex concepts strategies or technical details into clear concise and visually appealing presentations suitable for managementlevel audiences.
• Design and develop slides using presentation software (e.g. PowerPoint Keynote) to effectively communicate key messages and insights.
• Ensure slides adhere to organizational branding and formatting guidelines.
• Leverage IT background to understand technical concepts terminology and industry trends ensuring accurate representation in presentations.
• Bridge the gap between technical teams and management by effectively communicating... ITrelated information in a business context.
• Conduct research and analysis to gather supporting data statistics and examples to strengthen presentations.
• Collaborate with subject matter experts to validate information and ensure accuracy.
• Work closely with stakeholders including executives department heads and project teams to understand requirements and align presentation content with strategic objectives.
• Solicit feedback and incorporate revisions to meet stakeholder expectations.
• Manage timelines priorities and deliverables to ensure timely completion of presentation projects.
• Coordinate with crossfunctional teams to gather necessary inputs and resources.
• Stay updated on industry best practices presentation techniques and technology trends to enhance the quality and effectiveness of presentations.
• Seek feedback from colleagues and stakeholders to identify areas for improvement and implement enhancements accordingly.

Requirements
• Experience as IT Project Manager of at least 46 years
• Experience in developing managementlevel presentations
• Proficiency in presentation software (e.g. PowerPoint Keynote)
• Strong communication skills both written and verbal
• Ability to simplify and translate complex concepts for nontechnical audiences
• Working experience with an IT background understanding of IT concepts and terminology
• Analytical skills for gathering and interpreting data
• Attention to detail particularly in formatting and design
• Project management skills including time management and prioritization
• Collaboration and teamwork abilities
• Continuous learning and adaptability to stay updated with industry trends and best practices.
• Fluent english. Spanish would be nice to have.
• Strong agile mindset and experience in collaborating in agile teams and environments
• Familiar with agile ways of working (SAFe Scrum Kanban)
• Strong experience working in international environments and familiar/Comfortable with Global projects
• Experience in a highly regulated environment preferably Pharma would be a plus
• Project Management certification desired

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager, Professional Services
jobs_results.description:
About the position:

Netskope’s Global Customer Experience team is continuing to grow its project management practice. This role reports into Netskope’s Customer Experience Professional Services team.

Responsibilities include:
• Drive project kick-off activities: internal meetings, statement of work creation, project plan documentation for top-tier, high profile customers.
• Act as an escalation path for implementation projects to reset and clarify expectations.
• Oversee Netskope's customer installation engagements from a technical project management capacity.
• Schedule and oversee assignments, report on risks, issues, and accomplishments.
• Build strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal Netskope team members.
• Provide regular project updates to customers and Netskope leadership.
• Manage internal customer-related processes regarding scheduling, finance, and resource management.

Job Requirements:
• 6-8 years Project Management experience in services business or... team.
• Prior experience with Customer Success and/or Professional Services solutions, including Financial Force and Gainsight.
• Experience with resource management.
• Experience with project planning software, plus Smartsheet.
• Excellent interpersonal verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to self-manage - the team is globally distributed.
• Practical knowledge within the network security and/or SaaS industry.
• Proficient skills presenting complex schedules and tracking.
• The voice of calm in the chaos and ability to thrive with competing priorities.

Preferences:
• Technical experience implementing network security and/or SaaS-based solutions.
• Professional Services or Customer Success experience.
• Successful track record working with Fortune 500 companies.
• Successful track record working within a successful startup(s).

Education:
• Bachelor's Degree

#LI-NN1

Netskope focuses on Enterprise Software, Enterprise Security, Data Security, Software, and Mobile Security. Their company has offices in San Francisco, London, Melbourne, Santa Clara, and Tokyo. They have a very large team that's between 1001-5000 employees. To date, Netskope has raised $1.162B of funding; their latest round was closed on January 2023.

You can view their website at https://www.netskope.com or find them on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Product Hunt

jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Mexico

Job Profile Summary

Lead a program or multiple projects from start to finish. Inspires confidence in the team, senior management, and the business community implementing the project solution. Leads efforts to improve existing processes or programs and design new systems or processes as required. Advocates for Operational Excellence across the organization.
• *Must be fluent in English

Key Responsibilities
• Manage multiple concurrent projects with a well-defined scope, moderate complexity and limited, contained risk exposure
• Deliver project objectives by developing and managing schedule, scope, risks, and issues
• Assess and manage project variances (e.g., schedule variance); evaluate impacts to overall project commitments, evaluate and present options, and implement approved changes.
• Maintain accountability for managing expectations and ensuring quality.
• Maintain accountability for providing timely communications... managing expectations, and assuring quality.
• Provide tactical leadership regarding project priorities, timeline, resources, and issues.
• Provide ongoing work direction to the project team.
• Create an environment that enhances team motivation
Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree AND 3-5 years project/program management experience required
• Intermediate understanding of project management principles
• Intermediate knowledge of the project lifecycle
• Familiarity with project planning and support tools such as MS Project, Project Workbench, MS Office and Lotus Notes
• Ability to monitor progress and status of deliverables and communicate appropriately. Ability to capture status updates using the appropriate tools
• Ability to communicate the impact of status changes to overall project plan/progress
• Demonstrated delivery of service meeting customer expectations
• Excellent time management, communications, decision making, presentation, human relations, and organization skills
• Ability to balance scope, tasks, schedule, quality, resources, and budget
• Practical application of accepted project lifecycle practices/methodology
• Basic understanding of the business and related technology needs
• Ability to understand critical factors and impacts surrounding issues and to make a reasonable decision
• Ability to resolve problems in a timely manner. Ability to meet deadlines while responding well to constant changes and resource constraints
• Ability to communicate technical info and ideas so others will understand
• Nice to have: Certifications in Azure.
• Discover your inner Racker: Racker Life- Fluent, Bi-lingual (Spanish and English): interviews will be held in English.

#LI-JR1
#LI-Remote

We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world-class talent. Join us on our mission to embrace technology, empower customers and deliver the future.

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager (Agile/Scrum)
jobs_results.description:
About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled associates who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About the role:

Gartner is looking for a well-rounded Senior Project Manager/Scrum Master who can provide project and program leadership for its CPG technology team, which is responsible for developing web-based presentations and integrations to support Gartner’s Sales and Services applications. The candidate will be responsible for project deliverables, project schedule/budget, Relationship Management and Vendor Management. The ideal candidate will be someone who has worked in an Agile/SCRUM environment, has worked closely with business partners, has played a key role in supporting... internal applications and has demonstrable experience managing relationships/expectations of the business and development teams.

What you’ll do:
• Ensures Agile/Scrum process is implemented effectively and provides coaching at the team level to maximize its benefits.
• Exhibits desire to continuously learn new tools, techniques, and methodologies.
• Exhibit’s ability to run projects using the Agile Scrum methodologies, from small teams to large, with multiple outside dependencies and 3rd party project team members.
• Must have excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
• Interacts seamlessly with both business and project teams.
• Facilitate discussions that lead to the resolution of project issues and development impediments.
• Report project progress to management and executive level stakeholders.
• Communicates the release plan with key stakeholders and end users.
• Deep working knowledge and understanding of Agile Software Development Methodology and incremental delivery.
• Exhibits a desire to continuously improve and shows a track record of improvement.
• Should be able to balance operational and development needs of Sales and Services IT applications.
• Should be able to interact well with both internal associates and external clients in resolving operational issues.
• Develop processes to manage operational issues in a timely and efficient manner.
• Identify systemic operational issues/risks and resolve them as well as identifying root causes and process improvements to present similar issues.
• Project & Portfolio management , ability to do quarterly planning, capacity calculation and track execution and progress
• Well versed with Program Metrics like Plan Creation, Budget Tracking, Creating Weekly Status Reports, Sharing Monthly updates..

What you will need:
• 4-year degree (Computer Science, Information Systems, or relational functional field) and/or equivalent combination of education or work experience.
• 5 to 8 years of experience working in an Agile Scrum environment.
• Strong experience with the full software development lifecycle and software development methodologies (Agile).
• Excellent organizational and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
• Strong knowledge of programming documentation processes/procedures.
• Strong ability to understand client expectations and to resolve issues that may affect delivery.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively in a matrix organization.
• Self-starter, with a demonstrated ability to learn beyond formal training with a strong aptitude for delivering quality products.
• Preferred experience with Continuous Integration practices/tools and Open-Source Frameworks.
• Proven ability to organize and plan complex deliverables.
• Strong knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Excel and Powerpoint.
• At the project and portfolio level, ability to do quarterly planning, capacity calculations and track execution.
• Ability to remove impediments and track team progress.
• Proven expertise in team leadership and development.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

What you will get:
• Competitive compensation
• 23 days annual holiday and an additional day off for your birthday.
• Private Medical and Dental Care.
• Life and Disability Insurance.
• Public Transport Subsidy.
• Ticket Restaurant Card.
• Childcare Vouchers (Ticket Guarderia).
• IncentiFit - annual reimbursement for health-and-wellness-related activities.
• Pension Scheme.
• Tuition Reimbursement.
• Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
• Employee Assistance Program.
• Gartner Gives Charity Match.
• Relocation Assistance - a specialist to help you with all the appointments and paperwork.
• Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
• A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
• A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
• A hybrid work environment—enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
• New offices close to Glòries and the beach in the fantastic, “innovation and tech” 22@ district of sunny Barcelona.
• Fresh fruit, snacks, selection of teas, fair trade organic coffee and a fridge full of beer for our Thursday Beer O’Clock

And much more!

Please Note:

- Applications must be submitted in English.

- A valid EU visa/passport is required for this position.

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-MC1

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT), we deliver actionable, objective insight that drives smarter decisions and stronger performance on an organization’s mission-critical priorities. We’ve grown exponentially since our founding in 1979 and we're proud to have over 19,500 associates globally that support over 15,000 client enterprises in more than 100 countries.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our teams are composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. We believe that a diversity of experiences makes us stronger—as individuals, as communities and as an organization. That’s why we're recognized worldwide as a great place to work year after year. We've been recognized by Fortune as one of the World’s Most Admired Companies, named a Best Place to Work for LGBTQ Equality by the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index and a Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion by the Disability Equality Index. Looking for a place to turn your big ideas into reality? Join #LifeAtGartner

What we offer:

Our people are our most valuable asset, so we invest in them from Day 1. When you join our team, you’ll have access to a vast array of benefits to help you live your life well. These resources are designed to support your physical, financial and emotional well-being. We encourage continued personal and professional growth through ongoing learning and development opportunities. Our employee resource groups, charity match and volunteer programs keep you connected to your internal Gartner community and causes that matter to you.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by calling Human Resources at +1 (203) 964-0096 or by sending an email to ApplicantAccommodations@gartner.com .

jobs_results.title: Data & AI Accelerators Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
AstraZeneca is a global, innovation-driven biopharmaceutical business that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world's most serious diseases. But we're more than one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies. At AstraZeneca, we're proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration. Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

Department – R&D IT

R&D IT’s vision is to deliver the best science IT capabilities in biopharma, which we define as agile, responsive and fit-for-future. Our goal is to engage with our stakeholders as a strategic partner in delivering life-changing medicines to our patients. The desired effect of your role is to take accountability as a leader for delivering a ‘Best in Class’ IT experience within R&D IT.

Delivering the portfolio of projects and services... needs people with hybrid skill sets covering technical, analytical, project management, service management, BRM and business analysis skills, combined with an excellent knowledge of AZ Finance and Global Product and Portfolio Strategy processes. Our project managers lead or contribute to a range of projects including IT development, data management, analytics, AI, machine learning, business transformation and more. Our projects deploy a range of technologies including internal custom build solutions, packaged software, ERP solutions, Software as a Service as well as Cloud based solutions and BI tools.

Role

The IT Project Manager leads technology and/or business transformation projects/programs to ensure that they align to the vision and business strategy, and that true business value is delivered to the customer as a result. Having a strong partnership with the business and IT customer driving the demand for the solution is critical to success in this role.

The IT Project Manager is accountable for ensuring solutions solve key business needs in an integrated and simple manner, exploiting existing assets where feasible, and minimizing the long-term total cost of ownership. The role must also ensure that delivery occurs with a sense of urgency and speediness of response and can be completed within the approved program budget and schedule commitments, whilst continuously assessing risk and balancing the need for flexibility and agility with conformance to standard methods and tools.

Focus areas include stakeholder management across Business, IT, and vendor partners, risk management and delivery of business benefit. This role is also required to collaborate with others in Program and Project Management, and drive development of the project / program management capability across IT in a tangible and measurable way.

Key Responsibilities
• Leading cross-functional IT projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
• Working closely with R&D teams to understand their IT needs, translating these requirements into effective project plans and technology solutions.
• Managing and optimizing the engineering enablement capabilities, including DevOps, MLOps, CloudOps, security measures, process templates, and automation solutions.
• Serving as an Agile Scrum Master, facilitating daily scrum meetings, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospective meetings to ensure continuous improvement within the team.
• Coordinating with internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure the seamless integration of new technologies and systems into the existing R&D IT infrastructure.
• Developing and maintaining comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, risk assessments, and stakeholder communications.
• Implementing and advocating for best practices in project management and Agile methodologies within the team to improve efficiency and productivity.
• Overseeing the project budget, including forecasting, tracking expenses, and ensuring financial efficiency.
• Identifying, assessing, and mitigating project risks and issues, implementing solutions to overcome obstacles and ensure project success.
• Championing the adoption of automation solutions and process improvements across data and analytics platforms to enhance R&D operations.
• Facilitating knowledge sharing and skills development within the team, ensuring team members are up-to-date with the latest in technology trends and project management methodologies.
• Collaborating with the IT security team to ensure that all projects comply with regulatory requirements and company security policies.

Candidate Knowledge, Skills and Experience
• Technical, Science or Business degree or equivalent years of experience.
• At least 5 years of Project Management experience, ideally in a Pharmaceutical IT environment.
• Experience working in global organization and across cultural boundaries.
• Experience in Agile Project Management.
• Demonstrated skills interacting with Senior Leaders.
• Experience leading large projects /programs.
• Experience working with third party suppliers.
• Experience working in a highly regulated environment.
• Excellent relationship management, and influencing skills.
• An entrepreneurial mindset and the proven ability to shape innovative solutions.
• Well-developed organizational, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

Desirable Requirements:
• Master's degree preferred.
• Program/Project Management certifications preferred (Prince, PMP, MSP, Agile – Scrum, SAFe).
• Experience with data management tools and techniques such as ETL and data virtualization.

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements
